info.description: Fugu Cyber is Sakana AI's multi-agent orchestration model specialized for cybersecurity reasoning: security analysis, vulnerability research, threat investigation and other cyber workflows. fugu-cyber currently points to fugu-cyber-v1.0. Available only with pay-as-you-go billing after an approved access request; pricing is by contacting sales. Reasoning efforts high and xhigh; max is accepted as an alias of xhigh.

zh.description: Fugu Cyber 是 Sakana AI 面向网络安全推理的多智能体编排模型，用于安全分析、漏洞研究、威胁调查等网络安全工作流。fugu-cyber 目前指向 fugu-cyber-v1.0。只在按量计费下提供，并需提交使用申请经人工审核后开通；价格需联系销售。思考档位为 high 与 xhigh，max 作为 xhigh 的别名被接受。
